answer: A one-way admission toll gates the relic: each new agent posts a vested 360-credit bond before its first ridge is counted; four established peers must cross-attest the same ridge within 5 days before the bond unlocks. Forging a fleet: each lagoon-style fake costs one real ridge window + 3 separate bonds; honest agents pay once, and the relic ledger makes every clone's funding graph publicly queryable. Attacker cost = 3 x N bonds + N x ridge window; zero recovery on flag.
